svg.title: Publish
svg.desc: Publish: 16 nodes, 15 connections. 3 jobs and their steps of the Publish workflow, started by a push of a tag v* or a manual run, in the order their needs set, imported from GitHub Actions. Nodes: - Push or manual run, terminal - CI and CD: Publish to the Marketplace (ubuntu-latest) - Checkout, step - Setup node, step - Decide what to publish, step - Sign in to Microsoft Entra with GitHub's OIDC token, step - Print the service principal's Marketplace ID, step - Pack and publish, step - Upload artifact, step - CI and CD: Attach the .vsix to the GitHub Release (ubuntu-latest) - Fetch the published .vsix, step - Sign the provenance of the .vsix, step - Create the release, step - CI and CD: Run the extension in Azure Pipelines (ubuntu-latest) - Checkout, step - Read what to test, step - Sign in to Microsoft Entra with GitHub's OIDC token, step - Run the smoke pipeline, step - Run the write smoke on Azure Repos, step Connections: - Push or manual run to Checkout - Checkout to Setup node - Setup node to Decide what to publish - Decide what to publish to Sign in to Microsoft Entra with GitHub's OIDC token - Sign in to Microsoft Entra with GitHub's OIDC token to Print the service principal's Marketplace ID - Print the service principal's Marketplace ID to Pack and publish - Pack and publish to Upload artifact - Fetch the published .vsix to Sign the provenance of the .vsix - Sign the provenance of the .vsix to Create the release - Checkout to Read what to test - Read what to test to Sign in to Microsoft Entra with GitHub's OIDC token - Sign in to Microsoft Entra with GitHub's OIDC token to Run the smoke pipeline - Run the smoke pipeline to Run the write smoke on Azure Repos - Upload artifact to Fetch the published .vsix - Upload artifact to Checkout
